reviews.text: Professional and kind.   My dog loves going to this vet.    Makes life so much easier for me as she gets older.

Took freyja to Davisville Park Animal Hospital yesterday for her annual check up.   Freyja is nervous dog at the vet and there kind professional. They kept her calm while giving the vaccines and blood test.   There was no up selling of services.   They gave clear answers to my questions.  Would recommend them

Dr. Candace Martins and the entire team at Davisville Park Animal Hospital are absolutely wonderful! They are incredibly accommodating, patient, and compassionate, especially with pets who experience high anxiety or are prone to fear-based aggression during vet visits. They take the time to be thorough, explain everything clearly, and make sure you feel informed and comfortable with every decision. It’s clear that your pet’s well-being always comes first, and their approach is focused on what’s genuinely best for your pet rather than simply the bottom line. They also offer great options, like their Pet Health Club, to help make care more affordable on top of regular pet insurance. I’m so grateful for their care and would highly recommend them to any pet owner looking for a team that truly cares!

Our pup Harper has had numerous medical issues and the doctors and staff at Davisville Park Animal Hospital have been fantastic! They always make time for our girl and explain everything thoroughly. Thank you to Dr. Martins, Dr. Avery, Tash, and all staff for taking such good care of our Harper.
The staff everyone from receptionist vet tech and vet are very friendly and efficient with ways to entertain even the most difficult dogs to stay still and get the exam done

We are new to the area so we were looking for a new veterinarian for our dog. Davisville Park Animal Hospital made us and our dog feel at ease from the start. The staff were kind and efficient getting us an appointment right away.
Veterinarian Steve took his time getting to know our older dog and answered all our questions.
We feel we have made a lucky choice for all our dog’s health needs.
Vet was professional, listened to and answered my questions.
Waited a little but was worth it. I am happy to know that my cat is in hoof hands.
Everyone is warm and thoughtful. Griffin especially likes the liver treats. :)
Friendly, professional, organised, and caring staff. Practice is spotless as well. Laszlo and I were very happy with our first visit. We made the right choice to switch to this practice.

All of the staff were patient and attentive during our visit. We felt like they took the time to understand our pet and genuinely cared about our experience and worries as owners. It makes a huge difference when you feel like the staff really want to know you and your pet. Very appreciated.
The doctor was very patient and caring with my senior dog. He answered all my questions and took great care of his pain. I’m very grateful for the attention and care he received.
We love that you took the time to listen and help our senior pup with kindness.
Incredibly kind and helpful staff. So appreciative of their help as I tried to find a vet after our vet closed. Thank you Davisville!
Thank you!
Great care for our 15-yr old dog Toby
We’ve always had such a wonderful experience here! Everyone is so kind, caring, and gentle with our cat, and we truly feel that he’s in good hands every time we visit. 🐾❤️ …
Excellent service!
The staff is really great. Dr.Jess is extremely knowledgeable and patient. She answered all my questions and took really good care of my baby. I highly recommend this clinic for your fur babies :)

Everyone in this clinic they are all very helpful. Without their help my cat could had died. Immediate response was done andt they knew right away what is wrong with him. They sent a referral to the emergency hospital and my cat was sent to surgery the same day. Now my whisky is recovering nicely. Thank you so much! This means a lot to my whole family.

My visit to the Davisville Park Vet was a very pleasant and friendly experience. My dog Rudy needed a rabies vaccination and they were very accommodating and incredibly friendly and so nice. The staff were a pleasure to deal with. I was in urgent need to get him vaccinated because of an awful situation that occurred when he ran away from home and apparently bit someone with his tictac sized teeth which ended up in the 20 year old “victim’s” mother claiming that her son had to miss 3 days of work due to the injury. She then tried to extort money from us to cover the costs of his 3 days of missed work and the cost of his medication.
For some reason he required a tetanus shot because I guess my chihuahua had rusty teeth?
Anyhow. I’m so glad that the vet helped me out and I would highly recommend the  Davisville Park vet anytime, any day.

3 of our 4 cats went here. Smurf, Star and Olive all enjoyed exemplary care. As did our dog Podo who also benefited greatly from seeing the vet and staff here. I think my main takeaway is the staff are kind and compassionate without being judgemental or pushy. They have a great team. Thank you!

From the initial telephone Intake to meeting with Dr. Candace and then getting the recommendations based on the follow up results, it’s clear that every member of the team is caring, focused and well organized. Something that I especially appreciated in my unexpected visit for my cat Ellie.  Thank you!

Amazing experience with the entire team! Chris was incredibly knowledgeable and caring, and Steve was so kind and helpful throughout our visit. Everyone was professional, compassionate, and made us feel completely at ease. We’re so grateful for the wonderful care and highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares.
Dr Emily is very thorough ! I used to go to Juno and they wouldn’t inspect half the things Dr.Emily did. Pricing was also very fair Highly reccomend

I took our dog in for an ear infection.  The appointment was right on time,  the vet was calm and knowledgeable.  They were very quick with the onsite testing and evaluation and we given medication for our dog, which she is already showing definite signs of improvements.
As always the staff were amazing at Lila’s first visit to the vet - caring, professional and always focused on our pet’s well-being!

Davisville Park Animal Hospital was a fantastic experience!! Chantel helped me get a same day appointment for my dog Rio who wasn’t acting like himself. Doctor Emily was great and she answered all my questions. MJ was super friendly and I’m very happy to have found this location so close to my home. Thank you everyone! Will defiantly be coming back!!
Dr. Emily was kind, attentive, and answered all of our questions thoroughly! She was also excellent at handling my cat and made him comfortable.
The staff at Davisville Park Animal Hospital were kind, attentive and knowledgeable. We appreciate their good care of our senior Chihuahua mix fur baby.

Doctor Emily was so patient and understanding, listened intently and took every concern we had into account. Our cat was treated gently and with great care. Davisville Park Animal Hospital is the best experience we have had and would definitely recommend to any pet families!
The team at Davisville Park cares a lot about its patients and have always looked out for the health of our pets, with vets even checking in on them on their days off.
Dr. Martins is very thorough and takes great care of both of my dogs !
I go monthly and the team is always great…very caring and very knowledgeable.
We have been going to this vet for 12 years and we absolutely love them and trust them with all of our dog’s health. They are very personal and do not treat us, or the dogs like a number.

I just wanted to say thank you for your great work.And for making my nemo, feel so much better, and for making me feel so much better ❤️
I know this will be an ongoing process. And I am so glad that we will be going through it with you.. Special showdown to mike for being such a decent person to deal with.

Davisville Park Animal Hospital provided great care for my chocolate lab. Very patient and gentle with her being anxious at the appointment. Lots of support and cuddles during her annual visit. They are not pushy with extras to get for pets, but they’re also very informative.
Excellent care of our cat! Wouldn't go anywhere else!
Davisville Park Animal Hospital, it's staff and vets, are fantastic. They always help with friendliness and compassion, and I feel that my pets are in such good and capable hands while they're there.
Thank you!
I had a great experience with this clinic! The team is very professional, and I felt like my cat received excellent care from them.
The team at Davisville Park Animal Hospital always take amazing care of my fur babies ❤️🐾 They genuinely care and I know they give my animals the best care and attention. …
Everyone was great with Cooper. Really appreciate this. Thank you!
Always so caring and great with my pets, thank you so much!

All the staff were kind and welcoming and the vet herself was also patient; we felt like we had the time to ask anything we wanted. She gave full and complete answers to everything specific to our cats and we felt valued.

I absolutely love bringing my cats here! I just had a check up with Dr Candace and she was AMAZING! I felt they truly cared about my cats and didn’t feel like they pushed for any unnecessary treatments! They truly care about the well-being of the animal and everyone who works there is SO nice! 10/10! I’m so happy I found my forever vet!!! :)

UPDATE - Another visit, another AMAZING experience. These guys truly care and they only suggest treatments as needed. Thank you Dr Candace for taking such great care of Skittles yesterday - we adore you!!!

I also want to give a huge shout out to Kris! She’s helped tremendously with Skittles and Scribbles, but she’s also been such an amazing emotional support. It’s really amazing to have someone who cares so deeply about the wellbeing of your pets, but also the wellbeing of the pet parent❤️ Thank you so much for everything!

Spencer’s first trip to DPAH was smooth as silk! Right from the moment we walked in, the staff was kind and caring. Making what was surely a stressful experience for an adopted cat, easy peasy.  Thorough and detailed, all our questions were answered.  Thank you Dr. Candace and everyone at DPAH.

I go to Davisville Park Animal Hospital for 2 years now with my German Shepherd Dog.
This last visit was for an ear issue and annual checkup plus tick season medication.
The staff are incredibly friendly and knowledgeable and also respectful.
The Veterinarian’s are lovely and are not pressure pushers like some vets can be…..
I have never felt judged by a decision I have made here which I appreciate.
I would recommend to family and friends.
I even travel from downtown to come here. 5 Stars!

Can’t say enough good things about Davisville Park Animal Hospital. Incredible humans doing incredible work for their patients, while also being wonderful, kind, and very very patient with all the humans!

A great, caring team, always a pleasure. Everybody is kind and attentive and keeps one informed at all times during the visit. There is always a check-in after a visit and and an opportunity to ask questions.

My dog was rescued from a meat market in Thailand.  She is very frightened of any veterinary procedures to the extent she has to take tranquilizers before any visit but still remains very anxious.  The team at Davisville Park Animal Hospital understands her and treats her with respect and kindness.
Very professional and loving to animals!

Pepper is in such good hands here. I couldn't ask for a more loving and caring team to look after her health. The supportive care they provide to my little fur baby is absolutely amazing. I am especially thankful to the wonderful staff members like Dr. Martins, Cristiane, and MJ. Thank you everyone, and God bless!

I took my senior cat Tabby for a comprehensive check up including blood pressure check and bloodwork and, as always, the vet and the team were amazing! Tabby is nearly 20 years old and she is quite a difficult patient to deal with😁  Dr. Emily and her team were extremely gentle and caring with Tabby and were able to have everything done for Tabby without stressing her too much. I am very happy with the service at Davisville Park Animal Hospital and am always confident that my cat is receiving the best medical care when I take her in for her appointments.
Many many thanks to everyone at Davisville Park Animal Hospital!
Christine
Great vet office. I’ve been coming here for years and always received the best care for my dogs.

We have been taking our pup since the day we picked her up from her foster home….so almost 3 years. The staff and vets are very compassionate and always ready to respond to a phone call or email, sending us reminders when needed and always following up after a vaccine appointment to make sure there are no adverse reactions. Our pup is always showered with treats after each visit to the point whenever we walk by the clinic, our pup makes a point of stopping at the front door just hoping she’ll score yet another treat!
Very nice vets! Always take good care of my dachshund

I brought my cat Molly in because she had some puzzling symptoms. While in their care, she was treated so well that she now associates her cat carrier with treats and keeps going in there expecting more from me. I always felt like she was getting the best care and am happy to report she’s back to her silly self. Thanks to the whole Davisville Park Animal Hospital team!
The front office staff are all really knowledgeable and professional. Every Vet who has seen my cats is terrific!

Many thanks to the entire team at Davisville Park Animal Hospital for taking such incredible care of my pup before, during, and after her surgery. From the moment we walked through the door, we were met with nothing but warmth, kindness, and so many treats. Forever grateful Taro, and her mom ❤️

I’m grateful to Candance and Davisville Park Animal Hospital for taking good care of my kitty, they answered my questions and gave him an effective traitement to make him healthy again! I also appreciate the hours of this clinic as I was able to get an appointment quickly and after I finished work.
We appreciate the 5 stars, Phillippe⭐️
Thank you!

We love Davisville Park Animal Hospital!! All the staff are super friendly and take great care of our two goldens. Prices are fair. Big thanks to Dr Emily and team for taking great care of our boy Rusty after he was attacked and needed immediate care, her stitches were so meticulous and he healed up quickly. We will forever recommend this office.
Excellent.  Very caring and very knowledgeable.  Spent time with us, explaining issues and carefully listened to our concerns.  Great team.
Super helpful nail trimming a grumpy dog.
Thank you!

I had a very disappointing experience with this vet clinic. They made incorrect entries in my dog’s records, which caused issues with my insurance. Even after realizing their mistake, they were unwilling to fix or correct it. This kind of careless and unprofessional behavior is unacceptable when it comes to caring for our pets. I cannot recommend them based on this experience.

Just great experience! The team here was friendly and professional. My cat's butt had some smell/liquid issues, and those are all gone by the end of that day!
The only flaw might be lack of parking lot therefore I had to walk there.

We brought our new kitten Oscar for his first appointment. The team was so welcoming and caring. Our Vet was incredibly knowledgeable and tender.  We left as very happy new pet parents with a wonderful packet of how to take care of our new fur baby. Thank You so much❣️
Everyone is super friendly and knowledgeable. I always feel good when I go in with my dog. Highly recommend

We've had nothing but good experiences with Davisville Park! The vets are knowledgeable and listen intently to your concerns without dismissing them.  All the staff is so kind.  We've never had trouble getting an appointment, even within the same day when it's been critical to see someone. Would definitely recommend!

Excellent care and service. The staff was professional and genuinely cared about my pet’s wellbeing.

Definitely recommend
Davisville Park Animal Hospital is the Best 🌟. All the staff is professional and kind. Great place for our pets 🙏🏻🌟. …
Amazing Vet.
Thank you Ajay!
Kind staff and quick response. My cat felt comfortable with the vet; highly recommended.
Personable and knowledgeable staff and veterinarians .

Wonderful clinic and so helpful.The front desk staff are knowledgeable and pleasant, and check in with the vet about simple questions. Dr. Emily is so kind and reassuring. Milo is a difficult cat but she knew how to handle him well and manage his anxiety. I absolutely recommend without hesitation. Below is a picture of the beautiful Milo.
Our experience at Davisville Park Animal Hospital has been wonderful. The staff are kind, patient, and genuinely care about animals. We always feel confident bringing our pet here. Highly recommend!
everyone is super friendly and very informative. Its easy to see that they really care about their patients. the communication is also very fast and easy.
Amazing experience, thank you so much!

I cannot sing the praises of this clinic enough. My chronically anxious rescue dog (Paisley) completely trusts Dr. Candace Martins, although he still loathes going to the vet! I took him to the clinic on an emergency basis in August 2024. They literally dropped everything and I can say unequivocally that Dr. Candace saved his life. This was followed later by an unrelated, and successful, tumour removal surgery.  A lovely group of people who are truly dedicated to the care of animals.

We’ve been bringing our senior cat to Davisville Park Veterinarian Hospital for over 8 years—almost half his life! The staff there are consistently kind, caring, and compassionate. They take the time to make both pets and owners feel comfortable, and their professionalism gives us complete confidence in the care our cat receives. Every visit, whether routine or more complex, is handled with warmth and genuine concern. We’re grateful to have them supporting us and our cat through his final years.

We’ve been bringing our cat to Davisville Park Animal Hospital for over two years and highly recommend them. In addition to providing first rate medical attention, their staff are among the most caring and compassionate people you will ever encounter. They take all the stress out and make it an enjoyable experience for both pet and owner.
Thank you!
Good service , doctor and friendly staff😻 …
Caring. Compassionate. Helpful.
Thank you Ursula!

The wonderful team at Davisville Park Animal Hospital were so helpful when I needed to have my pet looked at for increased mobility issues.  They got me in to see the Doctor very quickly and the Doctor was so helpful in assessing the situation and recommending a course of action to make him comfortable and to do further testing to confirm the cause.  The Doctor is so caring, professional, and thorough.  She sent a complete summary of her findings to the specialists (with a copy to me) to assist them in determining the best next steps.  I know that I can contact them any time and they will be here for me and my pet.
Thank you Cristiane!

I’ve been coming to Dr. Martins at Davisville park for about 2 years now, having switched here from another vet and I have only the best things to say about her, all of the vet techs and the front desk staff and even the coop students at Davisville. I’ve actually been putting off writing this review because I don’t know how to even begin to express how far above and beyond Dr. Martins and all of the staff at Davisville Park have gone for me and my two cats.

When I switched here, my two cats were seniors, and we immediately had the whole gambit of complex medical problems to navigate. But Dr. Martins is helping me to navigate this with care and compassion. She has given me what must amount to just countless hours of free labour between appointments responding to all of my questions and concerns about their treatment plans or their test results. She (very patiently) talks me through the options, why a particular treatment is best, and how to understand their test results. She acts like I’m not even being difficult, even when I’ve sent her like 15 questions in response to test results. Over the summer, I wanted to visit some family, but my cats are really very medically fragile, but Dr. Martins worked with the closest vet to my family so I could do that. She’s spent time consulting with specialists to save my cats extra appointments and helps me think through really difficult decisions about their care vs their quality of life. Always with compassion and professional expertise. And, to be clear, my cat’s cases have been really tremendously complex (in fact, the other vet I saw over the summer even commented on these being quite the cases for my vet!). I really trust her advice. I also trust her to hear me, which is a way rarer quality than it should be!, about their care as well.

I’m fairly confident everyone here (or at least nearly everyone) knows my name at this point, and they’ve made an effort to make sure they were referring to me the way I wanted to be referred to. Everyone here is so kind, helpful, supportive, and they just clearly really love the animals so much. It makes going to the vet feel a little like you’re visiting some pals, which is just a lot less stressful! I really love this clinic and I am so grateful to them for the care they’ve given to my babies.

These are some pictures of my cats, cats who are generally so terrified of vets, on their way to or from the vets being comfortable and interested in looking around!

Thanks, everyone!
No smiling greeting. No comment at after the treatment on my pet.
Thank you!
Thank you!

After a through examination, my dog was diagnosed with lymphoma by the vet.  Although it is now being managed by an oncologist, the staff - both technical and office personnel are professional, pleasant and  responsive to my concerns.

I have a great experience. The receptionist was very nice, the room was clean and the Vets were very friendly and helpful. They have a Brazilian dermatologist Vet and this was in my opinion the most important thing, because my dog was with skin problems. I really recommend it.
Great visit with Dr. Cusmariu, Dr. Kavanagh, Eitan, and Sarah. My cat is a very feisty patient and the team was professional, patient and thorough, as always. Thank you once again!
Thank you!
Everyone helped make my dog feel safe and comfortable during her recent visit.  Staff went that extra mile to facilitate our needs.
Very knowledgeable team. Willing to help with any questions or concerns about your pet. Friendly team. Great atmosphere. Highly recommend.

I'm very upset with this clinic. I brought my dog in for an appointment I had made any hour before. I had a lot of trouble understanding the person who brought us to the examination room. As I waited I began to think about my last visit that ended in me making a complaint to the owner. As the 25 minute mark approached I decided I would leave because I value being on time and good communication and i was getting neither. Just then the doctor walked in and gave some sort of excuse. I then confirmed the fee with her as I has been quoted a price that was surprisingly on the low side. In the spring, the clinic quoted me that an exam and vaccines would cost over $350 ($205 + tax for the exam alone) but I couldn't afford that at the time. This time the cost was $205 +tax for both. The vet said the initial quote was a mistake. So now instead of getting the 3 year rabies vaccine I could get one that's good for only a year. I'm very upset to say the least! They are always trying to up sell without having conversations that take the dog and owner into account.
Caring and friendly staff. The doctors always explain everything calmly and thoroughly. I never feel pressured to accept additional (optional) services are suggested.

I'm gonna share the poor experience we had and I don't want any reply from Davisville Park Animal Hospital. Tiger my 13 year cat was in need of dental care, knowing how expensive it was still decided, it's important.

Costly for exam, bloodwork & prescriptions. The worst part was getting the bloodwork,. Already familiar with the procedure. Felt it was usual with taking over 30 minutes, when Tiger came out, she was super stressed. Bloodwork cleared for surgery but 2 days before Tigers dental appointment, they canceled, said they would rebook, never did.

Now 6 months later Tiger sadly passed in her sleep. Clearly no clue if they were other issues going on but never informed. I don't trust this place at all. Highly unprofessional.

In addition, have a kitten that needed to be fixed. If you in need, highly recommend the Toronto Humane Society, best animal care ever received. People who actually care & help animals.
Kind and attentive staff. Great advice!
Awesome
Wonderful staff  in every way.
Thank you!
Amazing service. Very good package for senior cats.

I couldn't have been happier with my visit to Davisville Park Animal Hospital.
All the staff were professional and caring.
The Vet's, Tech's and Admin are all very helpful and friendly here. They have always been very attentive and on top of things for me and my 2 little ones!
Highly recommended! Great team and service.
Thank you!

I have been taking my fur-babies to Davisville Park Animal Hospital for over 13 years. There is no other veterinarian with which I would entrust my babies' health and treatment.

The front staff are extremely pleasant, polite, welcoming, helpful, professional and knowledgeable.

The doctors are all brilliant in their fields, highly skilled and provide the most professional care with their superb expertise. Everything that is required to assist my fur-baby is explained thoroughly and the best course of action is taken to heal whatever ails her.

My little girl just had surgery (poor baby) and I was just beside myself with worry. I must have called my wonderful DPAH office 20 times before her procedure with questions and concerns. Each call was received with the most caring and encouraging support with comprehensive answers to all my questions. I apologized for the many calls and each and every time the compassionate staff expressed their understanding of my concerns and told me my anxiety was understandable when it came to my little girl's health and safety.

As it turned out I had no reason for my concern as the incredibly skillful Dr. Candace Martins took the utmost of care and vigilance for my baby's wellbeing and the surgery went beautifully. The staff showed their outstanding care and professionalism post surgery providing me with superb aftercare instructions. My Beajou was her energetic self as we left the office only 6 hours after her surgery - I could finally breathe. I was contacted by DPAH early morning the day after her surgery to ensure everything was going well with my girl - their concern and follow-up is exemplary!!

Email notifications advising of environmental concerns and upcoming treatments required are sent in an extremely timely fashion. DPAH is fastidious as it relates to each individual pet care needs.

Davisville Park Animal Hospital are my heroes!
I’ve found the service, accessibility, professionalism (from the front office staff to the vet technicians and vets) all to be exceptional. I’d highly recommend.
The doctors at the hospital are great they are considered and take good care oof my dog

Dr. Candace Martins was knowledgeable and friendly. She was not pushy at all like some other clinics we have been to.

**Edit: I visited a second time with my dog and asked for a nail trim and was not informed beforehand that it would cost $50. This was with another vet.
Thank you!

I’m extremely disappointed and frustrated with the care my dog received at this clinic. When we brought her in for a spay, they ended up making a larger incision than usual and using staples instead of regular stitches due to “unexpected bleeding.” But when we came to pick her up, the vet didn’t even bother to speak with us. We were told by a vet tech to email the doctor if we had any questions. Seriously? After a major surgery?

Worse, they sent our dog home without prescribing any pain medication. She was in visible pain all night, she cried and couldn’t sleep all night long. We had to call the next day to ask for pain killer meds — something that should’ve been planned for and handled before she was discharged. Completely unacceptable.

We were told there would be two follow-ups: one for a post-op check, and another to remove the staples. But during the first appointment, they took our dog to the back without us and returned 15–20 minutes later saying they had already removed the staples — without informing us beforehand. That decision was made without our consent or even a heads-up. We were shocked and upset.

Then, at the second appointment, we were once again told we couldn’t go with her. They brought her upstairs to see the vet, and we never got to speak with the doctor directly. Instead, everything had to go through the vet tech, like some game of broken telephone. If the doctor has time to see my dog, she should have time to talk to the actual owners and explain what’s going on.

The entire experience has felt cold, disorganized, and frankly careless. The lack of communication, the way owners are excluded from basic procedures, and the disregard for our dog's comfort and our right to be informed — it all feels incredibly unprofessional. We expected better.

Clean and modern hospital! Dr.Candace is literally the best vet I've ever been to! You can tell she actually cares for pets well being which is a breath of fresh air, I recommend seeing her!! She took care of my cat Romeo when he was vomiting and not eating for days. She explained everything in a way for me to understand and didnt try to upsell me on anything at all. The whole staff is friendly and nice. Theres no parking which is frustrating but not a deal breaker. The prices in corporate vet med is disgusting as a whole but thats VetStrategy’s fault not the staffs!

Dr. Avery is great at what he does, and all of the front desk staff and nurses are super sweet and enthusiastic with every animal (and human) who walks in.

I will forever be grateful to Dr. Avery and his team for their compassion when my youngest cat had a heart attack en route to our vet appt and was pronounced dead on arrival 💔, and for helping me navigate through the cremation process with Pets Above. I received a signed card from Dr. Avery and the hospital staff afterwards offering their condolences as well, which I have kept to this day. I feel they really gave my baby the respect he deserved in his passing, and were very sensitive to what I was going through.

Dr. Avery doesn't recommend anything you don't need, he doesn't overcharge, and he is attentive and listens to my questions/concerns. I genuinely trust that he is looking out for the well being of my pets.

Edit:

We have recently moved to a new clinic that is closer to home, but it is now 2025 and I would still recommend Davisville Park Animal Hospital to anyone. Our experience with them was amazing. We'll miss you guys! 🐱🐈‍⬛🐶🐾
Thank you for your review!

I’m extremely disappointed with the care we received at this clinic a few years ago — and unfortunately, my dog is now paying the price for it.

Back then, the vets never gave a proper diagnosis regarding my Yorkie’s dental health. Instead, they repeatedly pushed for annual dental cleanings under general anesthesia, which I was absolutely not comfortable with. My dog is only 5 lbs — putting him under every year felt unnecessarily risky and irresponsible.

We chose instead to have his teeth cleaned professionally twice a year without anesthesia at other reputable clinics using ultrasound — a much safer alternative, especially for small breeds. But this clinic insisted on doing it their way and completely dismissed safer options.

The worst part? Without any symptoms or active treatment, they casually noted “dental concerns” in his medical record 3–4 years ago. And now, because of that vague and unhelpful note, my current insurance refuses to cover his dental treatment — at the exact moment when he actually needs help.

This is not just about dental care — it’s about poor communication, pressure-based service, and a lack of thoughtful, individualized treatment planning. I would not recommend this clinic to anyone with a small dog or a senior pet.
Super friendly staff!

Always a great experience for Suzy! She loves coming and seeing all the staff who spoil her with love, affection and sometimes even treats! They treat Suzy like she was their own… Couldn’t be luckier to have such a great Vet’s office!
Thank you for your kind review
Great experience throughout! Great booking system. Dr Emily is fantastic - took very little concern and question we brought up seriously

Davisville Park Animal Hospital has supported us through regular visits and more challenging times. Each time we visit the clinic we are greated by friendly and caring staff who work to make us and our four legged friend feel comfortable.
Thank you for your kind review!
Thank you!
Great clinic with caring staff. Dr. Jessica is fantastic and very knowledgeable. They have been caring for my precious dog for the past 7 years.
Fantastic vet! Not only are they some of the nicest people, but they are also incredibly accommodating and quick when you need an appointment. Highly recommend.

These guys never fail to amaze us. Super friendly staff that are always willing to help, quick to make appointments, and the way they care is like no other. I’ve gone to other vets for past pets, but since moving to Toronto, it’s safe to say this place is my favourite.
Dr Candace is an angel! My cats were really scared before and they would get all stressed at the vet and after they met Dr Candace they love going to see her. Really gentle and loving with animals.
Thank you!
Thank you!
The Vet was very helpful answering our questions and she gave their needles very well.  She even cut Jewels nails for me when I asked her to.  It was a great visit all around
Thank you!
Emily, the Veterinarian, who treated Cleo‘s ingrown nails, immediately put Cleo at ease and eliminated the problem effectively.
Thank you!

From the second I walked in the door the first time I felt confident and at peace I made the right decision for my puppy.  I love the team approach from the front desk to the vet to the technician who cuts my little guys nails (because I’m too scared to do it myself). Thank you to the entire team, I know Jack is safe in your hands.

I never leave reviews but this one is long overdue!! I hiiiiighly recommend Davisville Park Animal Hospital!!!! After waking up to my cat Daisy being suddenly very sick, I was in a sheer panic, Davisville Park fit Daisy into their schedule …
